children: Genting's proposed rights issue is expected to comfortably secure shareholder approval, as it requires only a simple majority of votes cast and the founding Lim family has committed to subscribe for its entire 45.1% stake, CreditSights' Jonathan Tan Jun Jie and Lakshmanan R say in a note. The planned 1.25 billion ringgit fundraising will largely be used to repay debt and is expected to modestly reduce net leverage by 0.2X-0.3X to 4.3X. The move looks positive for Genting's credit quality, although refinancing and credit-rating downgrade risks remain amid heavy capital spending and a weak outlook, they add. CreditSights maintains an outperform rating on Genting's subordinated perpetual bonds. Shares are 2.1% higher at 1.48 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
